site_surface.short_summary: Sultai Brood is a source-authored, review-gated Tarkir wedge packet for Black-centered BGU ruthlessness, opportunity, graveyard/resource conversion, necromancy, Sidisi-era ambition, and strict Silumgar and Dragonstorm boundaries.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Sultai asks what power can be made from every body, secret, cost, and opportunity before anyone else can claim it.
site_surface.tagline: Turn opportunity into power. Keep the dead useful. Leave no advantage unclaimed.
best_for: readers drawn to ruthless opportunity, necromancy, graveyard/resource conversion, and calculated advantage
players who like graveyard value, theft, morph, mutate, and complex creature value as support-only Commander texture

content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Sultai material can involve exploitation, coercive magic, necromancy, undead labor, poison, body-part relic practice, betrayal, life-force harvesting in Silumgar contrast material, and oppressive hierarchy. This packet keeps thin card, biography, Commander, and detailed Dragonstorm chronology topics deferred.

core_identity.summary: Sultai Brood is the Black-centered BGU Tarkir wedge expression whose source-bound floor is ruthlessness, opportunity, graveyard/resource conversion, necromancy, wealth through exploitation, Sidisi-era ambition, and strict timeline separation from Silumgar clan and modern Dragonstorm-era Sultai.
core_identity.philosophy: Black supplies ambition, cost-paying, theft, resource denial, and permission to seize advantage. Green supplies life, death, bodies, land, poison, and decay as usable material. Blue supplies planning, hidden information, redirection, mind pressure, and strategic selection.
core_identity.central_tension: Vox Mana synthesis models Sultai's tension as resource use becoming domination when Black ambition and Blue calculation overrule restraint.
core_identity.interpretive_note: Central-tension and metaphysical compression are Vox Mana synthesis from normalized SULTAI evidence plus VM-210/VM-211 shaping docs. They are not official Wizards or MTG canon.
